clauses: This distinguished figure was a renowned chemist, politician, and university teacher who notably served as the president of the French Academy of Sciences.

His profound contributions to the field of chemistry earned him numerous international honors, including being elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society and a Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences.
Additionally, he was awarded the Pour le Merite for Sciences and Arts order, and his legacy is immortalized as one of the 72 names on the Eiffel Tower.
However, despite his multifaceted scientific career, he never worked as a pharmacist, nor did he ever hold seat 40 of the Academie francaise.
